title: Custom Shutdown
description: This mod allows players to set corresponding real-world time points for automatic shutdown/restart of the computer.
body:
1. This mod allows players to choose a corresponding real-world year-month-day-hour:minute:second (for example: 2025-11-16-00:27:20) for the computer to automatically shut down or restart at that time point.
2. When the set time point is reached, there will be a 10-second reminder in the chat bar, and moving the mouse over the reminder text and clicking can cancel the shutdown/restart.
